query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing persistent fouling in our solvent regeneration system for CO2 capture. What chemical additives or surface modifications could mitigate this long-term performance degradation?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and recommend chemical additives or surface modification strategies to mitigate persistent fouling in the solvent regeneration system used for CO2 capture, to improve long-term performance and efficiency.
query_analysis.primary_domain: Fouling Mitigation in CO2 Capture Systems

selected_agents.role: Lead expert on fouling mitigation strategies
Identify and analyze root causes of persistent fouling
Analyze chemical interactions affecting fouling and assess effectiveness of additives

communication_strategy.information_flow: Root cause analysis and mitigation strategy development

clarification_questions: What specific fouling mechanisms have been identified in your system?
Can you provide details on the solvent composition and operating conditions?
Have any fouling mitigation strategies been previously implemented, and what were the results?
